# Guinea-Bissau Administrative Divisions

> Open dataset of Guinea-Bissau's administrative hierarchy:
> 9 regions, 39 sectors, 3,905 tabancas.
> CC-BY-4.0 licensed.

## Quick Reference

- Total regions: 9
- Total sectors: 39
- Total tabancas: 3,905
- Coordinates: included (all levels)
- Last updated: 2026-08-20
- License: CC-BY-4.0

## Aggregate Data Files

- [All regions (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-admin-data/guinea-bissau-administrative-divisions/main/data/all-region.json)
- [All sectors (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-admin-data/guinea-bissau-administrative-divisions/main/data/all-sector.json)
- [All tabancas (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-admin-data/guinea-bissau-administrative-divisions/main/data/all-tabanca.json)
- [Flat array (NDJSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-admin-data/guinea-bissau-administrative-divisions/main/data/all-flat.ndjson)
- [Hierarchy tree (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-admin-data/guinea-bissau-administrative-divisions/main/data/hierarchy.json)
- [JSON Schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-admin-data/guinea-bissau-administrative-divisions/main/data/schema.json)

## Schema Fields

- id: Unique identifier
- level: 1 (region), 2 (sector), 3 (tabanca)
- name: Local and English names with URL slug
- code: Government codes
- parent: Reference to parent division
- ancestors: Full chain to root
- children_count: Count of children per level
- zip_codes: Postal codes (where available)
- geo: Geographic coordinates (lat/lon, WGS84, all levels)
